one_liner: Attio CRM has a broad public REST API with self-serve OAuth 2.0 and API keys, free-plan API access, webhooks, an OpenAPI spec and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with apps registered self-serve in the developer console. Workspace API keys (Bearer) for single-workspace use. HTTP Basic with the token as username is also accepted. Unpublished apps can only grant tokens to workspaces they're shared with.
access_notes: Free plan reportedly includes REST API and webhooks with no approval gate (supported only by third-party pages from the draft). Attio's own pages confirm MCP is on all plans and sign-up is free. Installing an app requires a workspace admin.
blocker_notes: No meaningful blocker. Free workspace gives API access and OAuth app registration is self-serve.

evidence.quote: There are two ways to generate an access token: 1. By implementing an OAuth 2.0 flow 2. By generating an API key for your workspace
We also support HTTP Basic Authentication, where the username is the token and the password is left blank
API and webhook access, App SDK, MCP server and workflows included; no credit card
You need an Attio account on any plan. All workspace members can use the MCP.
This allows developers to build apps that read and write information to and from Attio workspaces. You can also subscribe to events in realtime using webhooks.
Attio MCP is Attio’s hosted MCP server that gives AI tools secure access to your Attio workspace.
